firstLines: Samantha Cho
Durham, NC | (919) 555-0168 | samantha.cho@example.com | linkedin.com/in/samanthacho
SUMMARY
Board-certified physician assistant with four years in emergency and urgent care. I see 25 to 30 patients a shift,
work well in a busy department, and take the time to explain discharge plans so patients actually follow them.
LICENSES AND CERTIFICATIONS
• Physician Assistant, Certified (PA-C), board certified through 2030
• North Carolina physician assistant license, active
• DEA registration, active
• BLS, ACLS and PALS, current
CLINICAL EXPERIENCE
Pecanwood Health System, Emergency Department Durham, NC
Physician Assistant Aug 2022 – Present
• See 25 to 30 patients a shift in a 48-bed emergency department with about 70,000 visits a year
• Perform procedures including laceration repair, splinting, incision and drainage, and joint reductions
• Helped write the chest pain pathway for low-risk patients, cutting average stays by 2 hours
• Precept PA students from two programs, about six students a year
Quenmore Health Partners Raleigh, NC
Physician Assistant Jan 2021 – Jul 2022
• Treated about 35 patients a shift across three urgent care clinics
• Read X-rays with radiology overreads and managed common fractures and sprains
• Started a same-day callback list for abnormal lab results, cutting missed follow-ups
Ferrowby Medical Center Greenville, NC
Emergency Department Technician Jun 2016 – Jul 2018
• Took vitals, drew blood, ran EKGs and helped with procedures for about 40 patients a shift
EDUCATION
Wendlow College of Medicine Erie, PA
Master of Physician Assistant Studies Dec 2020
• Clinical rotations: emergency medicine, family medicine, surgery, pediatrics, psychiatry
Marlbrook University Greenville, NC
